s1.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a 7-mm poorly enhancing mass
Chest CT revealing a nodular lesion in the left lung field

raw.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a 7-mm poorly enhancing mass
Chest CT revealing a nodular lesion in the left lung field

shortlist.label: IgG4-related hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 levels and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary dysfunction and visual deficits consistent with lymphocytic hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, consistent with granulomatous hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Chromophobe pituitary adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing a 7-mm poorly enhancing mass, consistent with a pituitary adenoma

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 levels and systemic imaging findings consistent with sarcoidosis

raw.rationale: The patient's elevated IgG4 levels, hypopituitarism, and imaging findings of diffuse pituitary swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, along with a nodular lesion in the lung field, are consistent with IgG4-related disease, making IgG4-related hypophysitis the most likely diagnosis

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers or findings unique to lymphocytic hypophysitis in the case presentation

rejected.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
rejected.why: No granulomatous changes mentioned in the imaging or laboratory findings

rejected.label: Chromophobe pituitary adenoma
rejected.why: The presence of elevated IgG4 levels and systemic involvement (nodular lung lesion) suggests an inflammatory rather than a neoplastic process

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: While sarcoidosis can cause hypopituitarism and has systemic involvement, the specific elevation of IgG4 levels points more towards IgG4-related disease
